audit.corrected: Added "(12s CD at rank 1)" to the Key Ability Interactions report entry.

audit.why: Verified against the kit: R flags channel="interruptible — any CC cancels it", P/R flag trueDamage.

audit.corrected: No change; recorded as verified in notes.

edits.after: His Q Void Rift outranges your kit — he opens every trade, not you.

edits.before: W charge threat begins: the taunt governs their engage plans already.
edits.after: His Q-W poke chunks your duo while Justice Punch has no setup yet.

edits.before: Full kit: E-W the committed trade and the magic shield refunds their poke.
edits.after: Full kit now, but his rift-and-split poke still out-trades your engage.

edits.before: Zone with taunt threat and shield the margins — AP duos pay double rent.
edits.after: His range and true-damage passive keep you soaking, not trading evenly.

edits.before: Hero's Entrance online — every roam your duo survives, you end.
edits.after: Flash-E or R closes the gap and hard-cancels his channeled ult instantly.

edits.before: Late Galio is the anti-dive: taunt their engage off your carry and R the map's emergencies.

edits.before: Bait the answer, start the chain, and let your carry collect — engage trades are all-or-nothing; pick the all.

edits.before: Engaging into a banked disengage — the chain that starts answered is a donation with armor.
edits.after: His 1050-range Q and W outrange your whole kit — walking up just feeds free true-damage stacks.

edits.before: Track Vel'Koz’s Tectonic Disruption: The knockup starts the true-damage rotation — dodge it and the research stalls. It’s down or you don’t go.
edits.after: Track Vel'Koz's Tectonic Disruption (12s CD at rank 1) — dodge it and the true-damage rotation stalls. His R is a channel any knockup cancels.

notes: Same structural bug as other matchups on this page: phases[].side held the literal word "Skill" while content win[] already carried the real verdict, so side/rating/why were corrected without touching win[] (no-op avoided). Content layer (spikes/wants/whys) for this matchup was already high quality and correctly names the R as a channel that Galio's knockup/taunt hard-cancels, so it was left alone. Two dosFull/dontsFull bullets were tradeGood/tradeBad copy-paste bleed and were replaced with Void Rift's two-hit delay and the 1050-range poke fact respectively.
